title: Proactive profile seeding and unified eval-adapter consolidation
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: New model onboarding frequently produces sparse performance profiles because we rely on one-off, hand-curated prompt sets and opportunistic runner selections. This leads to churn when models change tokenization/sequence behaviour, and poor rollout decisions when the published profile doesn't reflect tail latencies for prompt mutations.

Goal: Create a proactive seeding pipeline and consolidate eval adapter implementations so profile generation produces stable, high-coverage performance artifacts on first publish. The pipeline will: (1) generate deterministic but diverse prompt mutations and dataset fold variations; (2) route seeds through a single unified eval-adapter surface that supports variable runner backends (hosted/dedicated/private); (3) emit a richer profile manifest (sequence length histogram, per-template p95/p99 latency, kv-cache hit characteristics, and checksumed model-version pin).

Why now: Increasing number of onboarding requests for new open weights and community forks requires predictable profile publishing to avoid costly re-runs and to enable safe automated rollouts and fallback policies.
acceptance_criteria: A1: New 'seedbank' generator produces N=500 deterministic prompt mutations for a provided dataset and annotates each mutation with a reproducible seed id and mutation type.
A2: Unified eval-adapter API (harness.v2.adapter) accepted by at least 3 runner backends (local-runner, hosted-stub, dedicated-emulator) with a feature-flag toggle.

A3: Profile publish artifact includes sequence-length histogram, token-cost estimate, p50/p95/p99 latency per template, kv-cache reuse rate, and model-pin checksum. Artifacts are uploaded to GCS with manifest versioning.

A4: End-to-end run for an onboarding job completes within budgeted compute (<= 120% of baseline harness run time) and produces reproducible profile on re-run (bit-identical manifest when seeds & model-pin identical).

A5: Basic telemetry: counts of seed mutation types, adapter fallback events, and profile publish failures are emitted to the metrics pipeline (Dataplane/Prometheus) and visible on the profile-generation dashboard.
A6: Migration guide and backward-compat shim exist so previously published profiles remain consumable by rollout engine for at least 90 days.
implementation_notes: Design the seedbank generator as a small library (python) with configurable mutation operators: tokenization-aware truncation, paraphrase sampling (via small paraphrase model), template variable permutations, and synthetic noise injection.
Create harness.v2.adapter interface with three calls: init_run(metadata), step(prompt_batch, runner_hints), finalize_and_emit(metrics). Keep payloads JSON-serializable and minimal.

Writer for profile manifest should output: artifact_version, created_at, model_name, model_pin, model_pin_checksum (sha256), dataset_id, seedbank_snapshot_id, sequence_length_histogram (buckets), latency_percentiles_by_template, kv_cache_reuse_rate, token_cost_estimate, checksums_of_raw_outputs (optional). Use newline-delimited JSON lines in GCS.
Add feature-flagging: seedbank + harness.v2.adapter behind ff: 'harness_seedbank_enabled'. Default off for existing critical pipelines until QA signoff.
Coordinate with runtime team on kernel scheduling heuristics for long sequence tests; may need small patch in runtime-1.18 causing dependency (see dependencies).
Add lightweight compatibility shim: harness.v1.compat_adapter that converts v2 adapter calls to existing runners to avoid mass runner refactors initially.
Estimate compute budget: a single onboard job with N=500 seed permutations and 3 warmup steps should be ~1.2x current baseline. We'll validate on small, median, and large model sizes in CI.
test_plan: Unit tests for seedbank ensuring determinism given a seed id and mutation config.
Integration tests: run harness.v2.adapter with local-runner and dedicated-emulator to validate emitted manifest fields and reproduce manifest checksums on re-run.
Performance tests: measure p50/p95/p99 latency for 3 canonical templates and compare to baseline profile; ensure no >20% regression in harness run time.
Chaos tests: introduce runner failure to validate adapter fallback telemetry and manifest marks 'partial' with error metadata.
End-to-end smoke: onboard a small open model using new pipeline and compare artifact to existing harness outputs for consistency and additional fields presence.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (opt-in): Merge behind feature-flag. Run on nightly onboarding jobs for 1 week to collect telemetry.
Phase 1 (gradual): Enable for 10% of onboarding jobs (random sampling) and monitor profile publication success rate and manifest diffs.
Phase 2 (wide): Default-on for new model onboarding after 2 P0 weeks with no critical failures. Announce migration window for teams using old profiles.
Rollback: Disable feature flag and revert to harness.v1 adapter. Ensure previously generated v2 manifests are still consumable by rollback engine.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Seedbank produces pathological prompts that trigger slow kernel paths. Mitigation: add token-length caps and a preflight 'fastPath' classifier to reject seeds exceeding configured latency threshold.
Risk: Adapter changes break existing runners. Mitigation: compatibility shim and contract tests against each runner; require runner maintainers signoff in PR.

Risk: Published manifests leak sensitive prompt content. Mitigation: strip PII at generation time and default to storing only checksums and synthetic metadata; raw outputs are marked 'sensitive' and stored in encrypted GCS with ACLs.
Risk: Increased compute spend. Mitigation: telemetry to track cost per profile and knob to cap seedbank size per model class.

2026-03-08 - Design review (Leah Patel): Requested explicit privacy controls in manifest to avoid storing raw prompts. Action: strip PII and include checksum-only by default.

2026-03-09 - Runtime review (Samir Rao): Flagged potential kernel scheduling regression for long sequences, added runtime-1.18 dependency and small patch proposal. Filing ENG-200101 for runtime follow-up.

2026-03-12 - QA (Maya Singh): Found intermittent non-determinism when paraphrase operator uses external model; recommended caching paraphrase outputs into seedbank snapshot to enforce determinism.

2026-03-13 - Diego Morales: Addressed QA feedback by snapshotting paraphrase outputs; updated PR and started canary runs behind feature flag. Next: add telemetry counters and finalize manifest schema.
